problem: After a note spelling save, a document-write failure previously left corrected ASR/checks persisted but old stale minutes. Saving the same note again returned success without completing the minutes replay.

change.outer: Store::with_terminology_savepoint owns the only SQLite transaction after requiring is_autocommit; private SAVEPOINT commits only when outer RELEASE succeeds. Explicit operation or RELEASE failure rolls back; Drop handles unwinding without panicking on stderr logging errors. Existing caller transaction is rejected without mutation.
change.closure: Engine correction reads terms and schedules/edits/revisions/marks queue+checks/cache/meeting/prose+citations/history+ack under the same Store mutex and outer boundary. User note save is outside and persists; external meeting file sync occurs only after successful RELEASE and unlock.
change.inner: Native nested savepoints replace transactions only in mark_terminology_batch, edit_segment_text and repair_terminology_documents; commit_document unchanged.
change.stale_human_accepted_ambiguity_permissio: Unchanged; this patch does not broaden which articles or source spellings may be rewritten.

before_fix.observed: A document replay write failure left note+corrected ASR persisted, old stale minutes and consumed queue. Same-ID/content save returned success but retained the old article spelling.

limits: No migration of half-committed databases produced by older versions.
No relaxation of stale, human, accepted, ambiguous-name, source-revision or transaction guards.
Synthetic storage/retry tests do not prove arbitrary real-audio name recall or AI article quality.
No model/default/prompt/SDK/GPU-component/installer change for this production fix.
